Article Title: 5 NFL players who faced life-threatening incidents: How Tom Brady and other stars escaped near death situations
Article Text:
5 NFL players who faced life-threatening incidents: How Tom Brady and other stars escaped near death situations(Getty)

1. Tom Brady escaped a scary car accident before the 2010 season

2. Ben Roethlisberger survived a motorcycle crash that shocked the NFL



3. Jesse Palmer feared for his life after becoming stranded in Fiji

4. Chad Jones nearly lost his leg after a devastating crash



5. Ryan Shazier refused to give up after a career-threatening spinal injury



These stories remind us that football is only part of their journey



Football is one of the toughest sports in the world, but some NFL players have faced battles that had nothing to do with the field. Long before kickoff or after the final whistle, a few stars found themselves in situations where simply staying alive became the only goal. Some were involved in devastating vehicle crashes. Others survived freak accidents or dangerous circumstances that could have ended much differently.In many cases, those frightening moments changed the way they looked at life. Some returned to football, while others were forced to move in a different direction. Here are five NFL figures who came dangerously close to tragedy and lived to tell the story.Tom Brady's career is filled with unforgettable victories, but one of the biggest scares of his life happened away from a football stadium.In Sept. 2010, the former quarterback was driving through Boston when his Audi collided with a Ford minivan at an intersection. Reports said Brady was shaken by the impact but did not suffer any serious injuries. He did not need medical treatment and left the scene shortly afterward. The Patriots were preparing for the start of the regular season, and fans immediately feared their franchise quarterback had been hurt.Fortunately, those concerns disappeared quickly. Brady returned to practice the very next day and never missed a game because of the accident. What could have become a career-changing event instead became little more than a frightening memory.Ben Roethlisberger experienced one of the most serious off-field accidents involving an active NFL player. During the summer of 2006, the Steelers QB was riding his motorcycle in Pittsburgh when he collided with a car. Roethlisberger was not wearing a helmet at the time. The impact left him with facial fractures, a broken jaw, missing teeth and deep cuts to his head.Doctors performed emergency surgery that lasted several hours. At first, there were real concerns about how severe the injuries were and whether he would ever return to football. Roethlisberger recovered much faster than many expected. He was back on the field later that season and continued building what eventually became a Hall of Fame-worthy career. Looking back, he admitted the accident changed his perspective and said he would wear a helmet if he ever rode a motorcycle again.Jesse Palmer's close call had nothing to do with football. The former Giants quarterback, who later became a television personality and host of “The Bachelor”, revealed in 2026 that he nearly died while filming “The Bachelorette” in Fiji several years earlier.After production wrapped on a date, Palmer stayed behind on a small island hoping to enjoy the scenery. What seemed like a relaxing moment quickly turned dangerous when a storm rolled in and rising tides began swallowing the beach.Palmer later recalled believing he might have to tread water in the open ocean and hope a boat eventually found him. He admitted that, for a brief moment, he thought about the possibility that he might not survive.Fortunately, a boat arrived before the situation became even worse. Palmer escaped unharmed, but he has often described the incident as one of the scariest experiences of his life.Chad Jones had barely begun his NFL journey when disaster struck. The former LSU standout was selected by the New York Giants in the 2010 NFL Draft. Just weeks later, his Range Rover slammed into a utility pole in New Orleans during an early morning crash.The damage was so severe that firefighters had to cut the vehicle apart to free him. Jones suffered multiple fractures in his left leg along with serious injuries to his foot. At one point, doctors worried they might have to amputate part of the limb. Instead, Jones underwent several surgeries followed by months of rehabilitation. Although he eventually returned to football activities, the accident dramatically altered the course of what many believed would become a promising NFL career.His story remains one of the league's most heartbreaking examples of how quickly life can change.Ryan Shazier's life changed in front of a national television audience. During a Monday Night Football game in December 2017, the Steelers linebacker lowered his head while making a tackle against the Cincinnati Bengals. He immediately collapsed and lost movement in his legs. The frightening scene stunned teammates, coaches and fans alike. Shazier underwent spinal stabilization surgery and spent months learning how to walk again.There were genuine fears that he might never regain normal movement. Instead of giving in, Shazier attacked rehabilitation with remarkable determination. Videos showing him standing and eventually walking became powerful reminders of how far he had come. Although he never returned to NFL action, Shazier regained his mobility and has continued inspiring others through his recovery journey. His determination became just as memorable as anything he accomplished on the football field.Fans usually remember NFL players for touchdowns, championships and highlight-reel plays. Yet moments like these offer a different perspective. Tom Brady returned from a frightening car accident without missing a beat. Ben Roethlisberger overcame injuries that once appeared career-threatening. Jesse Palmer survived a terrifying experience far from any football field. Chad Jones battled through injuries that changed the direction of his career, while Ryan Shazier turned an unimaginable setback into an inspiring recovery story. Each incident unfolded under different circumstances, but they all shared one thing in common. Every player faced a moment that could have ended far worse than it did.Their careers may define them in the record books, but these stories reveal another side of professional athletes. They show resilience, perspective and an appreciation for simply getting another chance. Sometimes the greatest victory has nothing to do with lifting a trophy. Sometimes it is simply making it home.
Article Summary: Tom Brady escaped a car accident before the 2010 season. Ben Roethlisberger survived a motorcycle crash that shocked the NFL. Jesse Palmer feared for his life after becoming stranded in Fiji. Ryan Shazier refused to give up after a career-threatening spinal injury.

Article Title: “Wedding location revealed at 4AM”: American Century Investments CEO Jonathan Thomas reveals Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce wedding details
Article Text:
“Wedding location revealed at 4AM”: American Century Investments CEO Jonathan Thomas reveals Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce wedding details (Image 1 via Getty, Image 2 via X: Jonathan Thomas, Taylor Swift, and Travis Kelce)

Jonathan Thomas was invited to Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce wedding through a text

Jonathan Thomas elaborates on Taylor-Travis wedding

Swift Kelce wedding had games and amazing giveaways for guests

Please note: These are excerpts from The Compound & Friends podcast, where American Century Investments CEO Jonathan Thomas spoke about Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce ’s wedding in depth.It was in February or March 2026 that American Century Investments CEO Jonathan Thomas got a text that said:“This is from Taylor and Travis, and I promise this isn’t a spam…” Jonathan Thomas deleted it. Even though he knew Travis Kelce very well.A couple of days later, the text came again, and it kept coming in. Eventually, Jonathan Thomas blocked the number.About a few weeks or a month before the wedding in June, Thomas’ phone rang. It was Travis Kelce.And Travis goes, “Hey JT, you’re like one of the only people who haven’t responded to the wedding invitation. What’s going on?”Thomas never imagined the wedding invitation would come through a text message. Thomas told Travis that he never got an invitation.Travis said that they sent him tons of messages every couple of days. Thomas admitted that he deleted them and later blocked the number.He asked Travis why they sent an invite through text. Travis said, “Everybody like you in this party is never in one place. They are in different places.And the work it would take to figure out when you’re gonna be where is way too much, and we had everybody’s cell phone numbers, and we have a few very people.”Thomas has blocked tens of thousands of people. He could not unblock Travis’ number.So, Travis asked for Thomas’ wife, Cindy’s number. Then she got all the updates about the wedding.When Thomas finally got the invitation through a text, there was multi-factor authentication. It took a while to go through that process.Then came the non-disclosure agreement. Thomas and his wife, Cindy, had to sign that. Then came the actual digital invitation.It was watermarked with Jonathan and Cindy Thomas in the background.“I won’t get into the details about the NDA, but it had teeth. Let’s just put it that way,” Thomas said.First came “You’re invited to the wedding.” Then came “In New York. Then came “July 3rd Manhattan.”And “it wasn’t until 4 in the morning on the day of the wedding where we got the exact location [Madison Square Garden],“ Thomas said.Thomas said the wedding of Travis Kelce and Taylor Swift was amazing, and that everybody had fun. Adam Sandler officiated the wedding. Everybody was laughing and thought it was a joke. But Sandler actually did.Sandler spoke for 20 to 30 minutes. Sandler’s speech vacillated between funny and very sincere, and he sang a few things.When Sandler spoke about vows, one in particular, “for richer or poorer,” he added, “you’re not going to have to worry about that.”Sandler’s key message was “kiss each other, every day, in the morning, at night, after dinner, just kiss often.”Then Travis Kelce went first with vows. He spoke for 30 minutes. He was unbelievably vulnerable. His vows made Thomas want to cry.Thomas was trying to hold his tears. But when he saw 300-pound football players around him also crying, he let himself go.Travis’ vows were very powerful. And then came Taylor’s vows. She also spoke for 30 minutes. Her vows were poetic.The ceremony was very solemn, sincere, and emotional. They built a massive castle inside Madison Square Garden. It was incredible.Behind the castle were games and amazing giveaways for guests.Then came the stage where Taylor Swift sang with “The Beatles” singer Paul McCartney first.Then Swift sang with the Reigning Queen of Rock and Roll, Stevie Nicks. At one point, Thomas was dancing with his wife, Cindy, and he looked around.He found Paul McCartney to his left, Brad Pitt in front of him, and Cindy Crawford on the right. He was just surrounded by legends.The second part of the wedding was honestly dedicated to the guests.Taylor-Travis wanted to make sure the guests had a great time at their wedding.It wasn’t about the bride or the groom, like it’s found in usual wedding ceremonies.Their wedding was for the people they wanted to celebrate their most important day with. It was designed to delight the guests.
Article Summary: American Century Investments CEO Jonathan Thomas was invited to Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce’s wedding through a text message. Thomas has blocked tens of thousands of people. Adam Sandler officiated the wedding. Taylor Swift sang with the Queen of Rock and Stevie Nicks.
